title: Budget: subsets of 22
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 22 items, weights up to 10^12. Count subsets whose weight sum is in [L, R]. Time limit: standard.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Sort + sweep two pointers over items

**B)** Enumerate all 2^22 subsets directly and count

**C)** Meet in the middle: enumerate halves, sort one, binary search

**D)** Segment tree over weights

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: 2^22 ≈ 4·10^6 is borderline; meet-in-the-middle (2·2^11 = 4096 enumerations + a sort) has orders of magnitude of margin and matches the [L, R] counting.
